title:
Build the G1 gate artifact for Stage 1 (REQ-10 / AC-14 in .design/stage1-forge-tier.md; AC-8 in .design/thermite2-program.md). The gate needs a real end-to-end demonstration that does NOT yet exist. ENVIRONMENT (use directly, do not probe external files): Verus at /Users/maxine/verus-dist/verus-arm64-macos/verus — export VERUS_BIN=/Users/maxine/verus-dist/verus-arm64-macos/verus and add its dir to PATH; lake at /Users/maxine/.elan/bin (add to PATH); the forge --engine lean discharge needs the spine — build it once with: cd lean && lake build Thermite.Stabilize Thermite.Exec.Stmt Thermite.Exec.WhileBody (then cd back). z3 is bundled with verus. New verus/lake tests use the EXISTING verus_present()/lake_present() skip-guards.

Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit. STANDING SELF-VERIFY: python3 tooling/doc-drift.py (now topology-stable, #48 fixed — local matches CI) and RE-PIN the audited-sha of every design doc whose governed source you touch; tooling/reqs check; finish 0-drift.

SCOPE: the G1 gate ARTIFACT only — do NOT flip the README headline (R-GATE-1, separate step), do NOT author the governance docs (thermite2-semantics.md / R-rules / skill v2 — separate steps).

DELIVERABLES:
1. THE MERGE-CLASS EXAMPLE (the gate's centerpiece). Author a conformance example (extend conformance/forge/merge.th or add conformance/forge/merge_class.th) that is a SINGLE fn whose certificate exhibits clauses at **L4, L4, L3** and the item level is **L3** (min over clauses). Concretely: two ens clauses that are nlsat-RELAXABLE (universally-quantified polynomial atoms, no div/mod/shift/cast — these route to the NlsatEngine and certify L4) + one ens clause that is NOT relaxable (routes to verus/lean and certifies L3). It MUST also carry a witness { inhabit (...); falsify N; } block (≥1 author inhabit) so a covenant is produced. Ground the relaxable vs non-relaxable split in forge/src/relax.rs::classify_fn. The resulting certificate must populate ALL FOUR evidence blocks: covenant_evidence (from the witness), the axiom-gate record (lean/verus discharge), the re-elaboration mutation score (anti-Goodhart), and the burn receipt (proof tokens).
2. THE GOLDEN CERT + TEST. Commit the golden certificate (e.g. conformance/forge/merge_class.cert.json) and a conformance test (verus+lake-guarded) asserting: item level == L3; the three clauses' levels are L4, L4, L3 (engine attribution nlsat / nlsat / verus-or-lean); and all four evidence blocks are present + populated. This is AC-14's core.
3. THE SEVEN-VERDICT HERMETIC SUITE. AC-14 wants each of the seven verdicts (Proved, Counterexample, RealWitness, CovenantRefuted, Stuck, KernelBudget, Timeout) exercised by a hermetic test that actually RUNS in CI (the F4 lean job now runs the forge suite with the spine). Audit found 6/7 covered but RealWitness's PRODUCER path is only z3-gated (add an ungated/structural producer test or ensure the z3 one runs in the lean job) and KernelBudget has no end-to-end exercise (add one). Provide a clearly-named test per verdict (seven tests named for their verdict) so the gate's 'seven hermetic tests' claim is literally met. Keep the existing closure-instrumented never-degrades tests.
4. ZERO v1 REGRESSION. Adding the new example must NOT perturb the existing v1 golden certs — manifest.rs oracle_subset byte-identical for all conformance/*.cert.json + conformance/**/*.cert.json. Verify.

GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo test -p forge (VERUS_BIN set + spine built as above); clippy -p forge --all-targets -- -D warnings; fmt --check; doc-drift 0-drift; tooling/reqs check clean; v1 conformance oracle byte-identical. No stubs/TODOs.

REGISTRY: record the G1 gate progress — if there is a REQ-S1-10 / G1 entry pattern in .design/reqs/registry.toml, register REQ-10 (G1 gate) with typed evidence (the merge_class example + golden cert + the seven verdict tests); else add it. Do NOT mark the README/headline flipped.

SCOPE GUARDS: no cage/combinator-menu change; never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json or .claude/settings.json. git push is blocked — commit locally, end with a clear summary, the orchestrator pushes + opens the PR. One branch.
